timing_contract.wasmtime_scope: Cold whole process only; NOT isolated invocation.
timing_contract.background_activity: Unrelated host activity was not stopped; noisy samples retained.

before.description: Initial pending source with generated allocation disabled; no exact-object cache or constructor-view prototype. Private debug-control refactoring retained.

allocation.description: Unbounded generated allocation, no constructor-view prototype, no exact-object cache.

both.description: Unbounded allocation and rejected constructor-result view prototype, no exact-object cache.

budget.description: Allocation expansion cap 1200 plus constructor-view prototype, no exact-object cache.

compact.description: Allocation expansion cap 512 plus constructor-view prototype, no exact-object cache.

cached.description: Cap 512, constructor-view prototype, heap-owned exact-object cache, no prepared identity window.

pre-window.description: Cap 512, heap-owned exact-object cache, prototype removed, no prepared identity window.

window.description: Final source: cap 512, prepared identity capacity window, exact-object cache, no constructor-view prototype.

pre_window_counter_controls.note: Private untimed controls. Helper calls and avoided full admissions are different metrics; not exact final-window counters.

negative_control.omitted: Only compaction cache invalidation in isolated source copy.

limitations: Local dirty macOS ARM64; not CI.
No actual x64 or Windows execution.
ASan excludes JIT machine code and MoonBit runtime objects.
